name: blog_blogmark
schema:
CREATE TABLE [blog_blogmark] (
   [id] INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
   [created] TEXT,
   [slug] TEXT,
   [card_image] TEXT,
   [series_id] TEXT,
   [link_url] TEXT,
   [link_title] TEXT,
   [title] TEXT,
   [via_url] TEXT,
   [via_title] TEXT,
   [commentary] TEXT,
   [use_markdown] INTEGER
)
